data.name: Cli.Help
data.value:
{0}: opens Mac APFS disks read-only on Windows.
Usage: apfs info <source> Shows container and volume information apfs ls <source> [path] [-r] [--hash] Lists the contents of a folder apfs extract <source> <path> <target> Copies a file to Windows apfs check <source> [--full] Read-only self-check (reads all files, compares counters and name hashes); --full: structural consistency (block ownership, space manager, reference counts) apfs dump <source> Dumps internal structures (development: checkpoint, space manager, volume superblocks) apfs mount <source> [X:] Mounts volumes as drive letters (Ctrl+C unmounts); if there are several volumes each gets its own letter; --all for internal volumes apfs register / unregister (Administrator) WinFsp registration for physical disks
<source>: disk image file or \\.\PhysicalDriveN (requires administrator rights) Options: --volume N (volume index, default 0), --partition N (APFS partition index) Encrypted volumes: --password-prompt (asks for the password) or --password-stdin (reads the password from standard input)
